title: Term 3 and 4 Examination
instructions: This paper covers the work of Terms 3 and 4.
This question paper consists of 2 questions. Answer ALL the questions.
Read each question carefully before you answer it.

sections.title: QUESTION 1: Career Fields and Study Skills

questions.prompt: A person who enjoys helping and teaching people fits which Holland type?
Which institution offers vocational qualifications such as NC(V)?
Match each career to a Holland type.
Cramming the night before is more effective than spaced revision.
Using the urgent–important matrix, how should you handle revision for a test in four weeks' time?
questions.memo:
✓ It is important but not urgent (1)
✓ so schedule regular revision sessions now (1)

✓ A programme that combines theory and practical work experience (1)
✓ leading to a qualification, often funded by a SETA (1)

questions.prompt: Why should Grade 10 learners research career requirements early?
questions.memo:
✓ To make sure their subjects and marks meet entry requirements (1)
✓ and to set goals and keep options open (1)

questions.prompt: Which section of the Constitution protects the right to a healthy environment?
Match each problem to a health effect.
What is social responsibility? Give an example.
questions.memo:
✓ Acting in ways that benefit the community and society (1)
✓ Example, e.g. volunteering, clean-ups, tutoring (1)

questions.prompt: Describe how your class could plan a project to reduce litter around the school.
questions.memo:
✓ Identify the problem and its causes (1)
✓ Set a SMART goal (1)
✓ Plan actions, e.g. bins, clean-up days, posters, recycling (1)
✓ Evaluate the results (1)

questions.prompt: Give TWO causes of climate change.
questions.memo: Any two (1 each): burning fossil fuels; deforestation; methane from livestock and landfills; industry emissions

questions.prompt: Explain why water scarcity is a health problem.
questions.memo:
✓ People cannot wash or keep sanitation clean, so disease spreads (1)
✓ Less water for drinking and growing food (1)
